name: Dumbbell Side-Lying External Rotation
steps: Lie on your side with a small rolled towel placed between your top elbow and your ribs.
Hold a light dumbbell (1 to 5 lbs) in your top hand with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rest your forearm across your abdomen.
Keeping your elbow pinned against the towel roll, rotate your forearm and dumbbell upward toward the ceiling.
Pause for one second at the top of the rotation, then slowly lower the dumbbell back across your stomach.
coaching_cues: Use very light weight; the rotator cuff muscles are small stabilizers that respond best to light, strict resistance.
Do not roll your body backward to swing the weight up.
Keep your wrist straight and firm throughout.
